188.content: Sacred Sites are significant geographic locations in Setting Canon. The First Den is the legendary birthplace of the first pack; its location remains heavily debated. Moon Wells are natural springs that amplify moonlight for bonding and healing rituals. Sacred Groves are ancient forests where hunting is absolutely forbidden. Ancient Forges are sites tied to the entity Ut, revered strictly by artisans and warriors.

189.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - Il Calendario Sacro -- The Sacred Calendar of Fenris
189.content: The Faith of Fenris rejects fixed solar dates. All sacred observances activate exclusively via lunar phase triggers. The Full Moon ceremony occurs precisely on the local night of the full moon, irrespective of the human calendar. Lunar reality dictates observance; solar dates are irrelevant.

190.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - January -- La Rinascita (The Rebirth)
190.content: La Rinascita, known as The Rebirth, triggers on the First Full Moon, called the First Howl. The ritual celebrates pack survival through winter. Packs renew hierarchical bonds and reaffirm the mandate Protect the Pack. The central rite is Pack Adoption. New members receive absolute pack bites from the Leader. All pack members sequentially scent new members from eldest to youngest. The Leader formally names each new member aloud.

191.content: La Vita (Life) is a werewolf ritual triggered by the First Quarter Moon, known as Freya's Blessing. The ritual is consecrated to Freya and honors Omegas and maternal figures. The central rite is Pup Naming. The Pack Leader explicitly names pups born during winter under growing light. This act formally establishes absolute parental bonds. Moon Speakers invoke Freya during the ceremony.

192.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - March -- Il Giuramento (The Oath)
192.content: [LSE LORE - CONCEPT: Il Giuramento (The Oath)]Triggered by the Full Moon (The Oath Moon, dedicated to Tyr). It is strictly the month of absolute promises and formalized social transitions. The most significant, life-altering Coming of Age ceremonies explicitly take place under this light.

193.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - March -- Il Giuramento (The Oath)
193.content: Il Giuramento (The Oath) comprises two dual rites. 1. Coming of Age: Juveniles (~13 years) presenting secondary sex undergo formal public acknowledgment, cementing absolute pack role and status. 2. The Call: Young adults (17-22) formally swear permanent pack allegiance or initiate Dispersal. Dispersal under this Moon incurs zero shame or debt.

194.content: La Memoria is a strict discipline of oral history and ancestral reflection triggered by the Waning Moon. Moon Speakers conduct formal, entirely unrecorded oral transmission sessions for the young. Sessions recount the brutal historical journeys of the Firstborn in full. Zero technology or abbreviation is permitted during transmission.

195.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - May -- Il Dominio (The Domain)
195.content: Il Dominio (The Domain) is a pack precept triggered by the Full Moon, designated the Border Moon. The ritual is consecrated to Skadi. The pack violently reasserts absolute territorial domain against all encroachment. The precept 'Respect the territory of others' is honored through aggressive enforcement of absolute control over one's own territory.

196.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - May -- Il Dominio (The Domain)
196.content: Il Dominio (The Domain) is a coordinated Rite executing massive territory patrols and deep scent-marking circuits across the entire boundary. All able-bodied pack members participate. Foreign packs in contested zones receive formal notification. This Moon establishes a strict legal window to raise territorial disputes before the Continental Council, preventing immediate bloody warfare.

197.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - Late Spring -- L'Approdo dei Primi (The Firstborns' Landfall)
197.content: L'Approdo dei Primi triggers on the First Quarter Moon of Late Spring. It commemorates the historical arrival of the Three Living Sagas—Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir—at L'Anse aux Meadows. It marks their southern migration founding the oldest New World werewolf domain. The holiday celebrates absolute resilience in exile. It holds high significance for New World packs and is respectfully observed globally.

198.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - Late Spring -- L'Approdo dei Primi (The Firstborns' Landfall)
198.content: L'Approdo dei Primi is a territorial claiming rite for wolves who completed The Call. Participants execute grueling ritual runs or swims across water boundaries, echoing the primordial ocean crossing. At dusk, Keepers light signal fires sequentially from north to south along borders. At each fire, Keepers recite the Saga of the Crossing. At dawn, the youngest pack members formally declare the territory their absolute own.

199.content: L'Ombra (The Shadow) triggers at the New Moon during Summer Solstice. L'Ombra is not a celebration. L'Ombra marks a hostile period where the sun dominates and the Moon is entirely absent. The longest day represents the Faith of Fenris' nadir. Fenris' light is hidden. The pack must brutally endure without breaking.

200.content: L'Ombra (The Shadow) observance mandates absolutely zero ceremonies. Extreme physical discipline and military-style vigilance are rigidly maintained. Hunts are strictly reduced to survival necessity. The pack absolutely forbids feasting and howling. The observance constitutes a severe test of endurance. A pack fracturing during June is deemed fundamentally and spiritually weak.

201.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - July -- Il Sangue (The Blood)
201.content: Il Sangue (The Blood) occurs during the Midsummer Full Moon, known as the Bonding Moon. This night represents the absolute apex of vital energy. It is the single most sacred night for permanent unions. Political marriages negotiated during Winter are consummated and biologically sealed on this night. Territorial alliances transform into absolute biological facts through this ritual.

202.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - July -- Il Sangue (The Blood)
202.content: Il Sangue (The Blood) is the werewolf bonding ceremony rite. Mates exchange a brutal, permanent mating bite under open moonlight. The entire pack witnesses the ceremony. A Moon Speaker officiates the rite. Political seals are entirely public. Il Sangue serves as the absolute deadline for fulfilling betrothals made at the previous Yule Ball.

203.comment: Tier 1 - LSE_Appendix - August -- La Custodia (The Stewardship)
203.content: La Custodia (The Stewardship) triggers on the First Quarter Moon. Keepers execute a month of rigid logistical preparation and infrastructure maintenance. Rites include rigorous purification of Moon Wells, re-consecration of Ancient Forges, and aggressive auditing of reliquaries. New Keepers are apprenticed. Moon Speakers brutally review the exact accuracy of oral traditions transmitted in April.
